blocks.text: Biodiversity aur classification biology ke buniyadi (basic) concepts hain. In se hum Zameen par zindagi ki beshumar shaklon aur un ke evolutionary rishton (relationships) ko samajhte hain. Is chapter mein hum biodiversity parhenge, yani genetic, species aur ecosystem levels par zindagi ki variety (rang-a-rangi). Hum biological classification ke usool (principles) aur tareeqe bhi dekhenge, jin se scientists jandaron (organisms) ko groups mein tarteeb dete hain.

Five-kingdom classification system American ecologist Robert Whittaker ne 1969 mein diya. Is system mein tamam jandar paanch kingdoms mein baante gaye: Monera, Protista, Fungi, Plantae aur Animalia. Kingdom Monera mein prokaryotes thay (woh cells jin mein asal nucleus nahi hota), aur baqi chaar kingdoms mein eukaryotes thay. 1990 mein American microbiologist Carl Woese ne bataya ke prokaryotes ke do alag groups hain: Archaea aur Bacteria. Isi buniyad par us ne jandaron ko teen domains mein rakha: domain Archaea, domain Bacteria aur domain Eukarya. Three-domain system mein Archaea aur Bacteria dono prokaryotes hain, lekin kai baaton mein ek doosre se mukhtalif (different) hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein naam “Rebert Whittaker” chhapa hai. Sahi naam Robert Whittaker hai; isi American ecologist ne 1969 mein five-kingdom system diya.

blocks.title: Phylogeny
blocks.text: Jandaron ke darmiyan evolutionary rishta phylogeny kehlata hai. Jo diagram phylogeny dikhata hai use phylogenetic tree ya evolutionary tree kehte hain. Ise khandaan ka shajra (family tree) samjhein: qareebi rishtedar ek hi shaakh (branch) par hote hain.

blocks.alt: Teen domains ka evolutionary tree. Common Ancestor (saanjha jadd) se ek tana (trunk) nikal kar do mein batta hai: ek shaakh Domain Bacteria tak jati hai (hare rang ka guchha, bohat si lineages); doosri shaakh phir do mein batti hai: Domain Archaea (peela guchha) aur Domain Eukarya (neela guchha).
blocks.caption: Figure 1.1: Teen domains ka evolutionary tree (kitab ki Figure 1.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Tree ko neeche se upar parhein. Neeche Common Ancestor (sab ka saanjha buzurg) hai. Pehli shaakh jo alag hoti hai woh Bacteria ki hai, yani Bacteria sab se pehle alag hue. Archaea aur Eukarya der tak ek hi shaakh par rehte hain aur baad mein alag hote hain; is liye Archaea aur Eukarya aapas mein zyada qareebi rishtedar hain. Har rangeen guchhe (cluster) ki chhoti lakeerein us domain ki mukhtalif lineages (nasal ki lakeerein) hain.

Ab biologists ka khayal hai ke Archaea aur Bacteria kisi saanjhe buzurg (common ancestor) se alag alag evolve hue. Molecular evidence (DNA aur proteins ka saboot) batata hai ke archaea bacteria ki nisbat eukaryotes ke zyada qareeb hain. Yani Eukarya Archaea se evolve hue, jab archaea Bacteria se alag ho chuke thay (Figure 1.1).
Domain Archaea

Five-kingdom system mein yeh domain kingdom Monera mein shamil tha. Archaea ka naam Greek lafz archaios se aaya hai, jis ka matlab hai “purana” (ancient). Yeh prokaryotes hain jo bohat purane zamane mein bacteria se alag ho gaye thay. Ek archaean ka diameter 0.1 μm se le kar 15 μm se zyada tak hota hai. Kuch archaea mil kar guchhe (aggregates) ya dhaage (filaments) banate hain jo 200 μm tak lambe hote hain. In ki shaklein mukhtalif hain: gol (spherical), chhari jaisi (rod-shape), spiral, lobed ya rectangular (chaukor lamba). Archaea asexual tareeqe se reproduce karte hain: binary ya multiple fission (cell ka do ya zyada hisson mein batna), fragmentation (tukron mein batna) ya budding (kali nikalna). Archaea mein mitosis aur meiosis nahi hote.
Shuru mein archaea ko bacteria ka hi ek group samjha jata tha aur inhein archaebacteria kaha jata tha.
Archaea mein khaas kya hai?
Cell membrane:

Archaea ki cell membrane ke lipids mein glycerol aur fatty acid chains ke darmiyan ether linkage (ether jor) hota hai. Fatty acid chains branched (shaakhon wali) hoti hain. Isi wajah se in ki cell membranes sakht halaat (extreme conditions), jaise bohat garmi, namak ya tezaab, mein zyada mazboot rehti hain.

blocks.alt: Do membrane lipid molecules saath saath. Baayein taraf archaeal lipid: glycerol head jis par phosphate group laga hai, aur do branched hydrocarbon chains jo ether linkage se juri hain. Daayein taraf bacterial ya eukaryotic lipid: wahi glycerol aur phosphate head, lekin do seedhi unbranched chains jo ester linkage se juri hain.
blocks.caption: Archaea ke membrane lipids ka Bacteria aur Eukarya se muqabla (Figure 1.2 ke mutabiq asal 3D model).
blocks.long_description: Dono lipids mein glycerol ki buniyad (backbone) hai jis par phosphate group laga hai. Archaeal lipid mein har chain ether linkage (carbon-oxygen-carbon) se juri hai aur chains par baqaida side branches hain. Bacterial aur eukaryotic lipid mein har chain ester linkage (carbon-oxygen-carbonyl) se juri hai aur chains seedhi hain.

fallback.text: Archaeal lipid: ether linkage, branched chains. Bacterial aur eukaryotic lipid: ester linkage, unbranched chains.

blocks.text: Doosri taraf bacteria aur Eukarya ke membrane lipids mein fatty acids glycerol se ester linkage (ester jor) ke zariye jure hote hain, aur fatty acid chains unbranched (seedhi) hoti hain.

blocks.text: Cell wall ki banawat:
Archaea ki cell walls mein cellulose aur peptidoglycan nahi hote. In ki jagah in mein alag qisam ke polysaccharides aur proteins hote hain. Kuch archaea mein pseudopeptidoglycan hota hai.

Doosri taraf bacteria ki cell walls mein peptidoglycan hota hai. Yeh sugars aur amino acids se bana ek polymer hai jo cell ko structural support (sahara) deta hai. Eukarya mein agar cell wall ho to woh plants mein cellulose ki aur fungi mein chitin ki bani hoti hai.
Genetic farq:

Archaea ki kai genetic sequences aur regulatory features (genes ko control karne wali khasoosiyat) eukaryotes jaisi hain. Is se pata chalta hai ke evolution mein archaea eukaryotes ke zyada qareeb hain.

blocks.title: Archaea ki ahmiyat
blocks.text: Jo archaea bohat zyada acidity (tezaabiyat) aur alkalinity mein rehte hain, un se aise enzymes milte hain jo sakht halaat mein bhi kaam karte hain. Maslan DNA replication ke enzymes aise archaea se nikale gaye hain. Yeh enzymes zyada temperature par sab se achha kaam karte hain aur laboratory mein DNA ki tez cloning (nakal banana) mumkin banate hain. Isi tarah methanogen archaea sewage treatment (gande paani ki safai) ka aham hissa hain: yeh anaerobic digestion (oxygen ke baghair tor phor) kar ke biogas banate hain. Acidophilic (tezaab pasand) archaea ko mineral processing mein ores (kachi dhaat) se sona (gold), cobalt aur copper nikalne ke liye istemal kiya jata hai.
Metabolism:
Archaea mein kuch khaas metabolic processes hote hain, jaise methanogenesis, yani methane gas banana. Yeh process na bacteria mein hota hai na Eukarya mein.

Doosri taraf bacteria mein photosynthesis, nitrogen fixation aur fermentation jaise metabolic raaste (pathways) hote hain. Eukarya mein metabolism aksar zyada complex hota hai; is mein cellular respiration, photosynthesis (plants aur algae mein) aur kai qisam ki fermentation shamil hain.
Archaea ke bare groups

Archaea ke bare groups yeh hain: Methanogens (metabolism ke by-product ke taur par methane banate hain), Halobacteria (bohat namkeen yani saline jagahon mein rehte hain), Thermococci (garam jagahon mein milte hain) aur Thaumarchaeota (nitrogen cycle mein hissa lete hain).

blocks.title: Kitab mein do naam
blocks.text: Kitab ki Figure 1.3 mein groups ke naam Methanogens, Halobacteria, Thermoplasmata aur Thermococci likhe hain, jabke paragraph mein Thermoplasmata ki jagah Thaumarchaeota hai. Paragraph wale chaar groups yaad rakhein, aur Thermoplasmata ko bhi archaea ka ek group pehchaan lein.
Insaan ki aanton (intestine) mein banne wali gas ka bara hissa methanogens ke metabolism ka nateeja hai.
Domain Bacteria

Five-kingdom system mein yeh domain bhi kingdom Monera mein shamil tha. Yeh asal (true) bacteria hain. In ki kai khaas khasoosiyat (characteristics) inhein doosre domains, yani Archaea aur Eukarya, se alag karti hain. Domain Bacteria ki aam khasoosiyat yeh hain:

items: Cell structure (banawat): archaea ki tarah bacteria ke cells prokaryotic hain, yani in mein asal nucleus aur membrane wale organelles nahi hote.
Cell wall ki banawat: bacteria ki cell wall peptidoglycan ki bani hoti hai, ek khaas polymer jo cell ko sahara (support) aur shakal deta hai.
Genetic material: archaea ki tarah bacteria mein DNA ka ek hi gol (circular) chromosome hota hai jo nucleoid region mein hota hai.

Plasmids: aksar bacteria mein DNA ke chhote gol molecules hote hain jo ek bacterium se doosre mein ja sakte hain. Is se genetic diversity aur adaptation (halaat ke mutabiq dhalna) mein madad milti hai.
Reproduction: bacteria zyada tar binary fission se asexual reproduction karte hain, jis mein ek cell bat kar do bilkul ek jaise (identical) daughter cells banata hai.

Ghiza ke tareeqe (nutritional modes): autotrophs apni ghiza khud banate hain (jaise photosynthetic bacteria), aur heterotrophs organic maadde se ghiza lete hain (jaise decomposers, yani gali sari cheezon ko torne wale).
Shakal (morphology): bacteria ki kai shaklein hain: cocci (gol), bacilli (chhari jaisi), spirilla (spiral) aur vibrios (comma jaisi).
Tarteeb (arrangement): cells akele, joron mein (diplococci), zanjeer mein (streptococci), guchhon mein (staphylococci) ya species ke hisaab se kisi aur tarteeb mein milte hain.
Flagella: bohat se bacteria mein ek ya zyada flagella hote hain, yani chaabuk jaise dhaage jin se woh harkat karte hain.
Pili aur fimbriae: kuch bacteria mein baal jaisi banawatein hoti hain. Yeh satah (surface) se chipakne aur doosre bacteria se genetic material ke len den mein madad karti hain.

Respiration: bacteria obligate aerobes (sirf oxygen mein zinda), obligate anaerobes (sirf oxygen ke baghair), facultative anaerobes (dono halaat mein), microaerophiles (thori oxygen mein) ya aerotolerant anaerobes (oxygen bardasht karte hain magar istemal nahi karte) ho sakte hain. Kuch bacteria oxygen na hone par fermentation se energy banate hain.
Extremophiles: kuch bacteria sakht halaat mein khoob barhte hain, jaise zyada temperature (thermophiles), zyada namak (halophiles) aur kam pH yani tezaab (acidophiles).
Pathogenicity (bimari phailana): kuch bacteria toxins (zehreele maadde) ya doosre virulence factors bana kar insaanon, janwaron aur podon mein bimariyan paida karte hain.
Symbiosis: bohat se bacteria doosre jandaron ke saath mil kar rehte hain: mutualism mein dono ko faida hota hai, aur commensalism mein ek ko faida hota hai aur doosre ko nuqsan nahi hota.

blocks.alt: Chaar bacterial cells ka 3D model: ek gola (coccus), ek gol kinaron wali chhari (bacillus), ek mura hua comma jaisa cell (vibrio) aur ek pech-daar spiral (spirillum), har ek par label laga hai.

blocks.text: Bacteria ke bare groups
Domain Bacteria bohat se groups mein bata hua hai. Maslan:

items: Proteobacteria, jaise Escherichia coli, Rhizobium, Helicobacter pylori.
Firmicutes, jaise Bacillus subtilis, Lactobacillus, Clostridium botulinum.
Actinobacteria, jaise Streptomyces, Mycobacterium tuberculosis.
Cyanobacteria, jaise Anabaena, Spirulina.
Spirochaetes, jaise Treponema pallidum.
Acidobacteria, jaise Acidobacterium.
Aquificae, jaise Aquifex pyrophilus.

blocks.text: Domain Eukarya

Domain Eukarya mein woh tamam jandar shamil hain jin ke cells eukaryotic hain. Yeh cells Bacteria aur Archaea ke prokaryotic cells se buniyadi taur par mukhtalif hain. Domain Eukarya ki aam khasoosiyat, jin ki wajah se ise alag domain mana jata hai, yeh hain:

items: Cell structure: in ke cells eukaryotic hain, jin mein asal nucleus nuclear membrane mein band hota hai. Cells mein membrane wale organelles hote hain, jaise mitochondria, chloroplasts (plants aur algae mein), endoplasmic reticulum, Golgi apparatus, lysosomes aur peroxisomes. Cells mein cytoskeleton bhi hota hai, yani microtubules, microfilaments aur intermediate filaments ka jaal jo cell ko sahara deta hai, harkat mumkin banata hai aur cell ke andar cheezon ko ek jagah se doosri jagah le jata hai (intracellular transport).

Genetic material: in ka DNA nucleus ke andar kai linear (seedhe, gol nahi) chromosomes mein tarteeb diya hota hai. DNA histone proteins ke saath jura hota hai, jo genetic material ko tarteeb mein rakhne aur control karne mein madad dete hain.

Reproduction: zyada tar eukaryotes sexual reproduction karte hain jis mein meiosis aur fertilization hote hain; is se genetic diversity paida hoti hai. Kuch eukaryotes mitosis ke zariye asexual reproduction bhi karte hain, jis se genetic taur par bilkul ek jaisi aulad (offspring) paida hoti hai.
Complex cellular organization: multicellular eukaryotes mein cells mukhtalif khaas qismon (specialized types) mein badal kar tissues aur organs banate hain, jin ke apne apne kaam hote hain.

Evolutionary rishte: khayal hai ke eukaryotes endosymbiosis se wujood mein aaye: ek host cell ne kuch prokaryotic cells (jo baad mein mitochondria aur chloroplasts bane) ko nigal liya, aur dono saath rehne lage (symbiotic relationship).

blocks.title: Kitab ki numbering
blocks.text: Kitab Eukarya ki khasoosiyat ko 1, 2, 3, 5, 6 number deti hai; number 4 chhapa hi nahi. Koi khasoosiyat ghaib nahi, sirf number chhoot gaya hai. Yahan inhein 1 se 5 tak likha gaya hai.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: Whittaker (1969): paanch kingdoms; tamam prokaryotes Monera mein.
Woese (1990): teen domains: Archaea, Bacteria, Eukarya. Archaea Bacteria ki nisbat Eukarya ke zyada qareeb hain.
Archaea: ether linkage wale branched lipids, peptidoglycan ke baghair cell wall, eukaryotes jaisi genetic khasoosiyat, methanogenesis.
Bacteria: peptidoglycan wall, ek gol chromosome, plasmids, binary fission, chaar shaklein (cocci, bacilli, spirilla, vibrios), flagella aur pili.
Eukarya: asal nucleus, membrane wale organelles, cytoskeleton, histones ke saath linear chromosomes, aksar sexual reproduction, endosymbiosis se aaghaz.

blocks.prompt: Peeche dekhe baghair teen domains ke naam likhein, aur do aisi khasoosiyat batayein jo Archaea ko Bacteria se alag karti hain.
blocks.explanation: Domains: Archaea, Bacteria aur Eukarya. In mein se koi do: Archaea ke lipids mein ether linkage aur branched chains, Bacteria mein ester linkage aur unbranched chains; Archaea ki cell wall mein peptidoglycan nahi, Bacteria ki wall peptidoglycan ki; methanogenesis sirf archaea mein hoti hai; archaea ki kai genetic khasoosiyat eukaryotes jaisi hain.
